name: deneb
label: Deneb (alpha Cyg, A2 Ia)
sources: Aufdenberg et al. 2002 (NPOI) / CHARA: theta_LD 2.363 +/- 0.002 mas (Aufdenberg 2002 had 2.40); distance ~ 430 pc (ASSUMED)
notes: A supergiant; H-alpha in P Cygni emission: the 1 nm H-alpha filter samples the wind.
Added 2026-11-04 for the C2PU 15 m H-alpha campaign: at 15 m and 656 nm a star is 20 % resolved at 3 mas and reaches the first null at 11 mas.
